replaceFiles.content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#08111b">
  <title>세계의 직조자</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/web-games/_shared/styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <script>
    window.GAME_CONFIG = {
      id: 'seed-casual-realm-weaver',
      name: '세계의 직조자',
      mode: 'realm',
      desc: '마나로 숲·물길·마을을 창조하고 세계 안정도와 인구 목표를 달성하는 캐주얼 세계 창조 게임.'
    };

    // Initialize game state
    let gameState = {
      progress: 0,
      progressTarget: 100,
      worldStability: 50,
      population: 0,
      resources: {
        wood: 0,
        stone: 0,
        water: 0,
        mana: 0
      },
      buildings: [],
      players: []
    };

    // Game logic
    function updateGame() {
      // Update progress
      gameState.progress += 1;
      gameState.progress %= gameState.progressTarget;

      // Update world stability
      gameState.worldStability += Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
      gameState.worldStability = Math.min(gameState.worldStability, 100);

      // Update population
      gameState.population += Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
      gameState.population = Math.min(gameState.population, 1000);

      // Update resources
      gameState.resources.wood = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
      gameState.resources.stone = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
      gameState.resources.water = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
      gameState.resources.mana = Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);

      // Update buildings
      gameState.buildings = [
        { type: 'forest', count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) },
        { type: 'path', count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) },
        { type: 'village', count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) }
      ];

      // Update players
      gameState.players = [
        { type: 'player', count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) },
        { type: 'assistant', count: Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) }
      ];
    }

    // Game UI
    function renderUI() {
      // Render progress bar
      document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = gameState.progress + '%';
      document.getElementById('progress-bar').innerText = gameState.progress + '%';

      // Render world stability
      document.getElementById('world-stability').innerText = gameState.worldStability + '%';

      // Render population
      document.getElementById('population').innerText = gameState.population + ' people';

      // Render resources
      document.getElementById('resources').innerText = `Wood: ${gameState.resources.wood}, Stone: ${gameState.resources.stone}, Water: ${gameState.resources.water}, Mana: ${gameState.resources.mana}`;

      // Render buildings
      document.getElementById('buildings').innerText = `Forest: ${gameState.buildings[0].count}, Path: ${gameState.buildings[1].count}, Village: ${gameState.buildings[2].count}`;

      // Render players
      document.getElementById('players').innerText = `Player: ${gameState.players[0].count}, Assistant: ${gameState.players[1].count}`;
    }

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
      updateGame();
      renderUI();
      requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
    }

    // Start game
    gameLoop();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
